_meta.purpose: Curated SEBI-category leaders used by xirrOptimizer.js to source SWITCH candidates for under-performing MF holdings. Seeded by Starbhai from public Value Research / Morningstar / AMFI 5y category rankings as of 2026-04. NOT a recommendation list — the optimizer ranks each candidate against the user's existing holding, applies tax + lock-in constraints, and only surfaces switches with material net uplift.
sourceCriteria: Top 5 per SEBI category by 5y trailing CAGR (Value Research / Morningstar)
AUM > Rs 500 Cr at last AMFI disclosure (avoids size-driven tail funds)
Total Expense Ratio (TER) <= category median (cost discipline)
Direct Plan only (regular plan adds ~80-120bps drag the optimizer would have to undo)
No funds under SEBI moratorium / segregated portfolios
_meta.disclaimer: These are reference candidates for analytical comparison only — NOT a buy list. Past returns do not guarantee future performance. Verify category rank, expense ratio, and lock-in status before any action with your IA / RA.

fields.category: SEBI category (used to match against user holding's category)
fields.name: Full scheme name as on AMFI / Groww
fields.isin: INF-prefix ISIN of the Direct Growth plan (when known)
fields.categoryRank5y: Rank within category by 5y trailing CAGR (1 = best)
fields.expenseRatioPct: Direct plan TER as last disclosed
fields.approxXirr5yPct: 5y trailing CAGR as a forward-return proxy (NOT a guarantee)
fields.lockInMonths: Statutory lock-in (36 for ELSS, 0 for everything else)
